meta.title: Ryugi
meta.description: Adds Ryugi mode and the Artboard to DeepSeek Harness. Ryugi mode starts every task on the using-ryugi workflow: brainstorm, draw the options on the Artboard, approve a spec, then hand the tasks to an agent team. The 画板 view sits after 对话 and 轨迹, and new artifacts open the Artboard in the right sidebar.
